title: Mismatch negativity and repetition suppression are prediction error

statements.text: Responses that encode prediction error should shrink with perceptual learning. This explains repetition suppression, the mismatch negativity and the P300 in electroencephalography.

sources.quote: It predicts the attenuation of responses encoding prediction error with perceptual learning and explains many phenomena such as repetition suppression, mismatch negativity (MMN) and the P300 in electroencephalography.
